definitions.explanation: A book or work written by two or more authors together. Also refers to the act of co-authoring. Common in academic and publishing contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{共著|きょうちょ}だ。
examples.english: This book was co-authored by two people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{共著|きょうちょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I published a paper co-authored with Professor Tanaka.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{著作|ちょさく}→著作：18234_chosaku⟧⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{単著|たんちょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{五冊|ごさつ}、{共著|きょうちょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三冊|さんさつ}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: His list of publications includes five sole-authored works and three co-authored ones.

notes:
USAGE: {共著|きょうちょ} is standard in academic and publishing contexts. In bibliographic references, it often appears after the authors' names, e.g., 「⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧・⟦{山田|やまだ}→山田：09529_yamada⟧{共著|きょうちょ}」.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {共著|きょうちょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to co-author
- {共著|きょうちょ}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: co-author
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{共著|きょうちょ}: co-authored with ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {共著|きょうちょ}: co-authored work (two or more authors)
- {単著|たんちょ}: sole-authored work
- {編著|へんちょ}: edited and authored work
- ⟦{著書|ちょしょ}→著書：14083_chosho⟧: authored book (general term)
